subject: Request: CAIQ/SIG + network isolation package for Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@acme.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: CAIQ/SIG + network diagrams for Dedicated/Private deployment

Hi Aditya / Kim,

We are kicking off our architecture review for the upcoming Acme pilot and the auditors asked for an initial CAIQ/SIG packet plus network and isolation diagrams specific to the Dedicated and Private deployment modes. Their timeline is tight — they want the package by EOD next Friday (2027-05-21) for an initial pass.

Specifically they requested:
- High-level network diagrams showing control plane vs data plane boundaries for Dedicated and Private (including optional air-gapped/on-prem variants)
- Egress/firewall flow for customer-controlled egress and KMS/HSM boundary mapping
- A SOC 2 mapping (points to control IDs where applicable) or any pre-existing SOC 2 narrative that covers these controls
- Completed CAIQ + SIG questionnaire answers (spreadsheet + PDF)
- Any redaction notes we need to include for diagrams (if applicable)

Can you confirm whether you can deliver a preliminary package by 2027-05-14 (so we can iterate before handing to the auditors)? Also send any preferred contact for the auditors (they may reach out to verify diagrams).

Thanks,
Claire Zhang
Security Engineering (Acme Corp.)
claire.zhang@acme.com

[Attachment: Acme_Audit_Request_20270511.pdf]

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask. Kim and Karthik are looped in; we can assemble a first-pass package by 2027-05-14 EOD (US/PST).

Plan:
- Kim will prepare network diagrams (control plane/data plane, egress flows, KMS boundaries) and a short technical narrative for redaction guidance.
- Karthik will surface the SOC 2 mapping and SIG/CAIQ artifacts we can share.
- I'll package everything, generate a PDF bundle and provide a secure link for your auditors.

If the auditors need a named contact for verification, point them to docs@thirdparty-audit.com and cc me. If there's anything in particular they want emphasized (e.g., hardware HSM placement, tenant-fencing illustrations), flag it and we'll prioritize.

Deliverables (prelim): network diagrams (svg), CAIQ answers (xlsx + PDF), segregation_matrix (xlsx), short narrative (PDF). Final package will be in a signed S3 link.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,

From: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ/SIG + network diagrams for Dedicated/Private deployment

Claire — attaching the first tranche of artifacts and a short summary below. Delivering the preliminary package today as discussed.

Summary:
- Dedicated: private GPU pool managed by Redwood Dedicated; control plane (orchestrator) is logically separated and lives in our control plane VPC. Data plane (inference hosts) resides in tenant-isolated subnets; optional customer VPC peering or private link is available.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): control plane can be run as a private control plane in the customer VPC or on-prem; for air-gapped installs we provide an on-prem bundle with documented egress/no-egress options.
- KMS/HSM: keys for customer-managed encryption at rest are stored in customer KMS when using Private; for Dedicated we offer customer-managed KMS integration across supported clouds. Diagrams show HSM placement relative to inference nodes.
- Egress flows: diagrams include typical egress paths and an "egress canary" example (used to show allowed destinations e.g., metrics sinks).

Attachments included (prelim):
- redwood_controlplane_separation_diagram.svg [high-level diagram, redacted IPs]
- egress_canary_flow.svg [egress example; annotated]
- caiq_answers_2027-05.pdf [PDF-export of the CAIQ answers we will submit]
- sig_questionnaire_answers.xlsx [SIG spreadsheet, marked with review notes]
- segregation_matrix_2027-05.xlsx [control mapping to network segments]

Drive link (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link

Notes on redaction: diagrams have hostname/IP redactions where required for Hosted Dedicated customers. If you need full topology with hostnames for internal validation we can provide a NDA-limited package or host an interactive session with your auditor and our network engineer.

Subject: SOC 2 mapping and sharing constraints

Claire — quick note on the SOC 2 / evidence side.

We maintain a SOC 2 Type II report for the Redwood hosted environment. The SOC 2 scope covers the Hosted API and Dedicated (when managed by Redwood) controls related to change management, logging, access controls and environmental safeguards. Private, on-prem deployments are out of scope for our hosted SOC 2 report but we provide documented evidence and architectural narratives for Private installs that map to the same control objectives.

I attached a short mapping matrix that links our SOC 2 control identifiers to the CAIQ/SIG questions where applicable. For the auditors:
- We can provide a restricted SOC 2 report excerpt and the control mapping under an NDA (if required).
- We cannot share customer-specific IPs in public diagrams; those are redacted and flagged in the packaging notes.

HubSpot deal link (for reference): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2025-0891
